The program is in `R/linreg.R`. `build.sh` creates `./app`, a small launcher that runs the script with Rscript. All 3 example cases in `node check.mjs` pass. A test input I generated at the maximum size (1,000,000 rows, 20 features, about 156 MB) took about 3 seconds.

It uses only base R and the bundled `stats` package. The fit centres the data before solving, to keep the coefficients accurate, and then recovers the intercept. Results are printed to 15 significant digits.
